## What's new

- Apps and Bookshelf scroll continuously instead of using pages. Bookshelf covers load as they come into view.
- Local folders and WeRead groups open in a compact three-column dialog. Closing it keeps your place on the bookshelf.
- WeRead sign-in keeps the QR code in place as it loads. Settings shows your name and avatar after sign-in when available.
- Bookshelf wallpaper export now previews the image and shows its save location. Save writes the image without a success dialog; Cancel writes nothing.
- The bookshelf uses a neutral empty message without showing WeRead sign-in or sync status.
